title: FRONT BUMPER BRACE & EXTENSION
summary: Front bumper support structure at the front of the frame: the bumper brace assembly and member assembly bolted together, the LH/RH bumper extensions on the front frame horns, and the outer braces at the fender skirt opening. Everything is bolted with lock and plain washers; the extension is held to the frame with nuts. Related sheet: A3 (front bumper & license plate bracket).

fastening.note: Bolt [2] goes down from above through lock washer [3], plain washer [4] and the flange of brace [1] into member [5]; a second bolt [2] with washers [3],[4] comes up from below (dashed line) into the brace/member joint at the square nut on the brace flange.
At the rear end of member [5] a bolt [2] with lock washer [3] goes up from below through the member end tab.

Nuts [6] (two shown) are run on from the inboard side of the frame horn; dashed lines lead from extension [7]'s upper flange to slotted openings in the frame. No bolt or stud callout is shown for these nuts.
Bolt [9] with lock washer [8] goes through the side of extension [7] from outboard (upper right of drawing).
Bolt [12] with lock washer [8] goes through the lower side of extension [7]; dashed line leads toward member [5].
Bolt [9] goes through lock washer [8], plain washer [11] and the outer brace [10] (at the fender skirt opening) into extension [7].

notes_internal: Item 1: fourth digit printed a little broken but reads 3 (3963129); a stray pen stroke runs above it.
Item 9 printed '9419101.' with a trailing dot; dropped.
Torque triangles: [2] has triangle 1 (three places); [6] triangle 2 (two places); [9] triangle 2 only on the lower right (outer brace) callout, the upper [9] has none. [12] has no triangle.
Nuts [6]: what they thread onto (stud on extension [7] or bolt) is not shown; treat with care.
Exact mating part for bolt [2] at the member [5] rear end, and for bolts [9]/[12] through extension [7], is inferred from dashed lines and is approximate.
